name: NeuS
aliases: NeuS — Learning Neural Implicit Surfaces by Volume Rendering for Multi-view Reconstruction
Learning Neural Implicit Surfaces by Volume Rendering for Multi-view Reconstruction
definition: Designed a volume rendering technique for surface representation to improve geometric reconstruction quality.
summary: NeuS is a neural surface reconstruction method that uses an unbiased volume rendering weight function to recover surfaces with first-order accuracy from multi-view images.
